The statistical method for Critical-level alerts.

The value of this parameter is determined by the `Statistics` column corresponding to the `MetricName` of the specified cloud service. Examples: Maximum, Minimum, and Average. For more information about how to obtain the value, see [Cloud service monitoring metrics]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html）.

At least one of the alert levels Critical (critical), Warn (warning), or Info (information) must be settings. The parameters Statistics, ComparisonOperator, Threshold, and Times within the specified alert level must all be settings
